rules.viirs_confidence: l low, n nominal, h high
rules.same_fire: same UTC date and within 1.5 km (chained)
rules.excluded: FIRMS type 2 (static land source) and 3 (offshore) are not counted as wildfires
rules.grid: 1.0 km squares per UTC date, origin 35.8N 35.75E; a square counts for a sensor if it has at least one vegetation fire point

live.note: NASA updates NRT data about every 3 hours
